PLAN "12-Week Low-Impact Strength Programme for Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Strength gains with knee-protection; progressive loading for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Cartilage/Technique (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower/Posterior Chain + Safe Quad Load":
        warmup:
          5 minutes treadmill walk
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian deadlift (DB or BB) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg extension (machine, light) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute bridge (bodyweight to loaded) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad stretch 60 seconds
          hamstring stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Quad-Safe Knee Strength & Core":
        warmup:
          5 minutes bike easy
        main straight_sets:
          goblet squat (use shallow depth) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg curl machine 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable abductor/adductor 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60 seconds
          calf stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pulling + Upper Stability":
        warmup:
          5 minutes rower at easy pace
        main straight_sets:
          incline bench press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat pulldown (neutral grip) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          facepull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          sliders/Tube knee-safe hamstring drag (modified) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder mobility 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progressive Load & Movement Quality (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower/Posterior Chain Progression":
        warmup:
          5 minutes bike
        main straight_sets:
          trap-bar deadlift (or hex bar) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split squat (DB bench-supported) 3x8..10 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute bridge, elevated 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip/quad mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Hip/Hamstring & Core":
        warmup:
          5 minutes elliptical low impact
        main straight_sets:
          Bulgarian split squat (supported) 3x8..10 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute-ham raises (assist as needed) 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable woodchop anti-rotation 3x10..12 per side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          farmer's carry (short distance) 3x30 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          kneecap tracking warm-up, mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Push Stability & Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          5 minutes row
        main straight_sets:
          push-up progression or bench press (control depth) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          one-arm landmine press 3x8..12 per side rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated cable row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          external rotation @ 30° 3x12..15 per arm rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder mobility 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3: Targeted Strength Peaks (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Max Strength Lifts with Safe Depth":
        warmup:
          5 minutes bike
        main straight_sets:
          5x5 deadlift (strict, controlled depth within comfort) rpe 8 rest 2 minutes
          4x6 front squat (shallow depth if needed) rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          hip thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          core circuit: 3 rounds of side planks 30s per side, dead bug 10 reps, rpe 5
        cooldown:
          foam roll + mobility 10 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper-Body Strength & Scapula Control":
        warmup:
          5 minutes elliptical
        main straight_sets:
          bench press or floor press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          pull-ups or assisted pull-ups 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          incline dumbbell press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plate pinches 3x30s grip work
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Posterior Chain & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          5 minutes bike
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          reverse hyperextension or back extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press with rotation 3x10..12 per side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          farmer's carry 3x40s
        cooldown:
          hip mobility 60 seconds
  FINAL NOTES:
  - No jumping, deep knee flexion under load. Keep ROM within safe ranges; avoid pain.
  - Emphasize tempo control and scapular stability, gradual progression.
  - Ski-specific transfer: include hip hinge, anti-rotation, balance with support if needed.
  - Reassess at week 12 and plan skiing progression accordingly.
